text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"sustained introduction, body paragraphs, and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"This captures having a clear overall structure that develops an argument across multiple paragraphs."},{"evidence":"repeated use of examples like \"Walt Disney created Micky Mouse,\" \"the Eiffel Tower,\" and \"prosthetic arms and legs\"","quality":"development","description":"This captures supporting ideas with concrete examples that expand and reinforce the main point."},{"evidence":"phrases such as \"incredible buildings stand tall\" and \"ways to construct them\"","quality":"idea elaboration","description":"This captures the ability to explain claims with more detail rather than only stating them."},{"evidence":"sentences with varied openings and embedded clauses","quality":"sentence variety","description":"This captures using more than one sentence pattern to create more mature and less repetitive prose."},{"evidence":"word choices like \"intricate,\" \"mesmerized,\" \"vital,\" and \"advancements\"","quality":"vocabulary control","description":"This captures using a broader range of precise academic and descriptive words."},{"evidence":"mostly readable sentences with only occasional errors like \"It's what sparks our creativity\" and \"an small little house\"","quality":"conventions control","description":"This captures better control of grammar, spelling, and punctuation even when some errors remain."},{"evidence":"consistent focus on one claim throughout the essay","quality":"coherence","description":"This captures staying on topic and linking paragraphs back to a central idea in a controlled way."}]}
